headline: Sources: Jaxson Dart to have season-ending knee surgery
summary: Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart is expected to have season-ending knee surgery, sources told NFL Network.

headline: Giants have various possible options at quarterback (but not many good ones)
summary: With Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart reportedly heading for season-ending knee surgery, the Giants have to make a decision about the quarterback position moving forward.

headline: Jets starting DT David Onyemata undergoes core muscle surgery
summary: Jets defensive tackle David Onyemata, a starter in the base defense, underwent core-muscle surgery and will be sidelined for several weeks.

headline: The Joey Porter Jr. situation lingers, with no end in sight
summary: With the Steelers facing the Bengals this weekend — and receivers Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins — it would be helpful to have cornerback Joey Porter Jr. on the field.

headline: Vikings RB Aaron Jones working through knee injury
summary: The Vikings' offensive backfield is in flux this week as starter Aaron Jones Sr. works through a knee injury and backup Jordan Mason remains on injured reserve.

headline: Lamar Jackson, Ravens not focusing on field conditions in Rio
summary: A day before the Ravens travel to Brazil to play the Cowboys, quarterback Lamar Jackson said he isn't focusing on the condition of the field at Maracanã Stadium.
